shared_or_similar_visual_information: Short repeated graduations along a straight ruler edge.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It marks a linear reading position on the ruler, which is labeled in centimeters. Right image: It marks a linear reading position on the scale labeled in decimeters.
Rationales: The evenly spaced short marks give linear reading positions along the ruler edge in both images. Ruler orientation does not alter the measured quantity.
